segments.sn8.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
segments.sn8.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
segments.sn8.8:1.3: Te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
segments.sn8.8:1.5: “ayaṃ kho bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
segments.sn8.8:1.6: Te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
segments.sn8.8:1.7: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyan”ti.
segments.sn8.8:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn8.8:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi –
segments.sn8.8:6.3: Sāvako te mahāvīra, pāde vandati vaṅgīso”ti.
segments.sn8.8:7.1: “Kiṃ nu te, vaṅgīsa, imā gāthāyo pubbe parivitakkitā, udāhu ṭhānasova taṃ paṭibhantī”ti?
segments.sn8.8:7.2: ‘Na kho me, bhante, imā gāthāyo pubbe parivitakkitā, atha kho ṭhānasova maṃ paṭibhantī’ti.
segments.sn8.8:7.3: ‘Tena hi taṃ, vaṅgīsa, bhiyyosomattāya pubbe aparivitakkitā gāthāyo paṭibhantū’ti.
segments.sn8.8:7.4: ‘Evaṃ, bhante’ti kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavato paṭissutvā bhiyyosomattāya bhagavantaṃ pubbe aparivitakkitāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi –
segments.sn8.8:8.1: “Ummaggapathaṃ [ummaggasataṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] mārassa abhibhuyya, carati pabhijja khilāni;
segments.sn8.8:8.3: Taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃ bhāgaso pavibhajaṃ.
segments.sn8.8:9.3: Tasmiñce amate akkhāte, dhammaddasā ṭhitā asaṃhīrā.
segments.sn8.8:10.1: “Pajjotakaro ativijjha [ativijjha dhammaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], sabbaṭṭhitīnaṃ atikkamamaddasa;
segments.sn8.8:10.3: Ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca, aggaṃ so desayi dasaddhānaṃ.
segments.sn8.8:11.2: Ko pamādo vijānataṃ dhammaṃ [ko pamādo vijānataṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)];

lines: Akutobhayanti nibbāne kutoci bhayaṃ natthi, nibbānappattassa vā kutoci bhayaṃ natthīti nibbānaṃ akutobhayaṃ nāma.
Isīnaṃ isisattamoti vipassito paṭṭhāya isīnaṃ sattamako isi.
Kiṃ nu te vaṅgīsāti idaṃ bhagavā atthuppattivasena āha.
Saṅghamajjhe kira kathā udapādi “vaṅgīsatthero vissaṭṭhavatto, neva uddese, na paripucchāya, na yonisomanasikāre kammaṃ karoti, gāthā bandhanto cuṇṇiyapadāni karonto vicaratī”ti.
“ime bhikkhū vaṅgīsassa paṭibhānasampattiṃ na jānanti, cintetvā cintetvā vadatīti maññanti, paṭibhānasampattimassa jānāpessāmī”ti cintetvā,“kiṃ nu te vaṅgīsā”tiādimāha.
Ummaggapathanti anekāni kilesummujjanasatāni, vaṭṭapathattā pana pathanti vuttaṃ.
Taṃ passathāti taṃ evaṃ abhibhuyya bhinditvā carantaṃ buddhaṃ passatha.
Pavibhajjāti vā pāṭho, aṅgapaccaṅgakoṭṭhāsavasena vibhajitvā vibhajitvā passathāti attho.
Tasmiṃ ca amate akkhāteti tasmiṃ tena akkhāte amate.
Dasaddhānanti pañcannaṃ, aggadhammaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ, agge vā pañcavaggiyānaṃ dhammaṃ desesīti attho.
Tasmāti yasmā esa dhammo sudesitoti jānantena ca pamādo na kātabbo, tasmā.
Sahassato paraṃ aḍḍhateyyabhikkhusataṃ tadā bhagavantaṃ payirupāsatīti āha “parosahassanti atirekasahassan”ti.
Nibbāne kutoci bhayaṃ natthīti kutocipi kāraṇato nibbāne bhayaṃ natthi asaṅkhatabhāvena sabbaso khemattā.
“khemañca vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desessāmi khemagāminiñca paṭipadan”tiādi (saṃ. ni.4.379-408).
Na kutoci bhayaṃ etasmiṃ adhigateti akutobhayaṃ, nibbānaṃ.
Vipassito paṭṭhāyāti amhākaṃ bhagavato nāmavasena isīnaṃ sattamabhāvadassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
Te hi tattha tattha sutte bahuso kittitā.
Isīnanti vā paccekabuddhasāvakabāhirakaisīnaṃ sattamo uttaro seṭṭhoti attho.
